purpose: Teach: キューブ/シグナル/ダイアリー/グリップ/トラフィック/ブレイク/追伸/フォーカス

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、キューブ型本社デザインを採用された
lines.en: You always adopted a cube-shaped design for the headquarters from the start.
lines.style: Gentle, measured cadence. Soft reverence in the voice — remembering without sentimentality. Pause slightly after the first clause, as if offering the memory for reflection rather than recitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは市場シグナルを読まれた
lines.en: Yes. He had a gift for reading the market.
lines.style: Steady acknowledgment. A quiet nod in the voice. Respectful but not effortful — the ease of someone who understands what's being honoured. Even pacing, grounded.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、毎日ダイアリーを書き続けられた
lines.en: He kept a diary every single day.
lines.style: Softer attack. Each word carries weight but lands gently. Slight wistfulness on 'every single day' — not mournful, but tender with the constancy of it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは商品のグリップ感を大事にされた
lines.en: Yes. He believed the feel of a product mattered as much as anything else.
lines.style: Reflective, almost meditative. Speaks from lived understanding. Slight emphasis on 'mattered' — not arguing, just confirming what he's learned. Warm but measured.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、サイト立ち上げ時のトラフィックを誇られた
lines.en: He took pride in those early numbers when the site first launched.
lines.style: Quieter, more introspective. A small smile in the voice — pride without boasting. Trails slightly on the final phrase, as if seeing those numbers again in memory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは会議のブレイクを欠かさなかった
lines.en: Yes. He never skipped the breaks in a meeting.
lines.style: Even delivery, matter-of-fact but warm. A small observation, stated simply — the kind of detail that reveals character. Minimal inflection, maximum attention.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、手紙の追伸で本音を伝えられた
lines.en: He'd put his real thoughts in the postscript of a letter.
lines.style: Slight amusement in the undertone. Understanding — almost affectionate — observation. Quieter on the second half, like sharing a secret about someone you loved. Warm fadeout.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは経営フォーカスを明確にされた
lines.en: Yes. He was always crystal clear about what mattered in business.
lines.style: Grounded, authoritative but not harsh. This statement lands like a conclusion — the fullness of understanding. Slow, measured cadence. A quiet finality with warmth underneath.
